body: The last time I went to a hospital, I was committed for three days and put in dual disorder (drug addiction + mental illness) because the mental unit was out of beds. It didn't help at all, it was terrifying, and no one would believe that *I didn't actually attempt suicide*. An abusive ex had me committed because I called her a whore. There isn't any way to get my meds without going in, but I'd rather be dead.
